After a failure, days +1 to +5 get x0.2. The status comes from data/events_state.json (set by watch.py or by hand) or from this config.

grain._why: SpaceX agreed on Oct 8, 2026 to buy Grain's 800 MHz licenses, pending FCC consent. While it's pending, merger odds in the next 14 days get x0.9 (a soft reason to sequence the deal after approval). On approval, the following 5 days get x1.2. Each run checks ECFS (Grain/SpaceX filers, proceeding 25-178) and Google News for approval wording. Detection is heuristic, so confirm by hand.

special_meeting_planned._why: If on, the merger vote is assumed to go to its own special meeting, so the e-proxy/Texas deadlines (urgency and timing anchors) stop pulling the merger letter forward. Letter timing uses plain weekday x calendar weights. The meeting-announcement ('either') curve is unchanged, and a letter only counts as 'meeting + merger' if it arrives by the time the meeting is announced. Result: merger-with-meeting falls and routine-only rises. Any letter that comes after the routine date belongs to the 2027 special-meeting path.

blank_reasons._why: Why is the 2026 meeting still unscheduled? Weights are set as of the clock start (Sept 21) and normalized. Each full blank week multiplies the active-process weight by x0.90 (processes leak), the quiet-hold weight by x0.98, and drift by x1.04.

inputs._doc: Used once the state is meeting_only (Dec 3 AGM set, routine). Headline = merger letter (or definitive agreement) by `by`, conditional on none so far. Dashboard number = (1 - market_weight) x rules model + market_weight x market composite, plus any smart-money nudge.
inputs._rules_why: Rules model: 0.6 x the pre-proxy merger share (letter_after_kill). With the committee signal on (Oct 20: both boards formed special committees), that share is 94%, so the rules number is 0.6 x 0.94 = 56%. The 0.6 keeps a haircut because Musk said no terms are agreed, there's no guarantee, and the Tesla vote needs 50% of all shares. Judgment, not data.
inputs._month_why: How the rules model spreads the letter odds over time. Spread fairly evenly, with a bit more weight in Dec (AGM Q&A, Day-180 unlock) and Feb (after SpaceX's Q4 results). Then multiplied by catalyst-day weights below.
inputs._market_why: Share of the dashboard number taken from the prediction-market composite. Markets often move before the news hits the wire, so they get real weight, but they are thin (a few $K a day), so not all of it.

market._why: Composite: every live Kalshi (definitive agreement before X) and Polymarket (announced by X) contract is treated as the same event. A volume-weighted monotone fit is drawn through them (weight = 24h volume, at least min_vol_weight). Polymarket 'announced' can include a non-binding letter, Kalshi needs a definitive agreement, so the two are not identical; the fit splits the difference.

smart_money._why: Flag 'Market moved before news': a contract moves 5+ pts in 24h with at least $1K traded and no filing or strict-filtered deal headline in that window. Nudge: if a flagged-quality move is 10+ pts within 72h, the dashboard adds 25% of that move (capped at 4 pts) on top of the blend, until news explains it or the move ages out.
